column3: Compound ID confidence given by MSI levels

MSI level 2 is accutrate precursor m/z and MSMS match but no rt match
MSI level 3 is accurate precursor mz_rt match w/o MSMS
MSI level 4 is Sugar Class specific, exact sugar not confirmed with rt
